### Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(modelsummary)
library(officer)
```

## Load tables, p.adjust and publish tables

#### Load tables for phenotypic results

```{r}
# evolution of flight performance
fltevol_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/fltevol_tables.RDS")

# factorial flight performance experiment
factflt_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/factflt_tables.RDS")

# activity data
act_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/act_tables.RDS")

# dry mass tables
mass_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/mass_tables.RDS")

# survivorship tables
surv_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/surv_tables.RDS")

# fecundity tables
fec_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/fec_tables.RDS")

```

### Tables: Evolution of flight performance

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(fltevol_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Save the ANOVA tables into a dataframe
flightevol_anames <- c("a_selgen", "a_CON", "a_FP")
flightevol_ANOVA <- mget(flightevol_anames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

flightevol_ANOVA <- flightevol_ANOVA %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Evol_Flight_Performance", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "a_selgen" ~ "Sel_Gen_fact",
    Model == "a_CON" ~ "CON_Gen",
    Model == "a_FP" ~ "FP_Gen"
  ))

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
flightevol_enames <- c("e_selgen", "e_CON", "e_FP")
flightevol_etasq <- mget(flightevol_enames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

flightevol_etasq <- flightevol_etasq %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Evol_Flight_Performance", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "e_selgen" ~ "Sel_Gen_fact",
    Model == "e_CON" ~ "CON_Gen",
    Model == "e_FP" ~ "FP_Gen"
  ))

# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
```

### Tables: Factorial flight performance

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(factflt_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Save the ANOVA tables into a dataframe
factflight_ANOVA <- a_fact_bestmod %>% 
  mutate(Model = "Additive_mod", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Factorial_Flight_Performance", .before = 1)

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
factflight_etasq <- e_fact_bestmod %>%
  mutate(Model = "Additive_mod", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Factorial_Flight_Performance", .before = 1)

# AIC table
factflight_AIC <- fact_aic
# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
rm(fact_aic)
```

### Tables: Activity assay

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(act_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Save the ANOVA tables into a dataframe
activity_ANOVA <- a_actmod %>% 
  mutate(Model = "SelxSex+Assay", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Activity_assay", .before = 1)

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
activity_etasq <- e_actmod %>%
  mutate(Model = "SelxSex+Assay", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Activity_assay", .before = 1)


# AIC table
activity_AIC <- act_aic

# Tukey table
activity_Tukey <- summary(tuk_actmod$contrasts)

# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
rm(act_aic)
rm(tuk_actmod)
```

### Tables: Dry mass

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(mass_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Save the ANOVA tables into a dataframe
mass_anames <- c("a_fit_sel_f", "a_fit_sel_m")
mass_ANOVA <- mget(mass_anames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

mass_ANOVA <- mass_ANOVA %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Dry_Mass", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "a_fit_sel_f" ~ "Sel_Females",
    Model == "a_fit_sel_m" ~ "Sel_Males"
  ))

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
mass_etasq <- e_fullmassmod %>%
  mutate(Model = "SelxSex", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Dry_Mass", .before = 1)

# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
```

### Tables: Fecundity

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(fec_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Save the ANOVA tables into a dataframe
fecundity_anames <- c("a_fec", "a_logfec")
fecundity_ANOVA <- mget(fecundity_anames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

fecundity_ANOVA <- fecundity_ANOVA %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Fecundity", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "a_fec" ~ "percapita_Fecundity",
    Model == "a_logfec" ~ "log_percapita_Fecundity"
  ))

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
fecundity_enames <- c("e_fec", "e_logfec")
fecundity_etasq <- mget(fecundity_enames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

fecundity_etasq <- fecundity_etasq %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Fecundity", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "e_fec" ~ "percapita_Fecundity",
    Model == "e_logfec" ~ "log_percapita_Fecundity"
  ))

# AIC table
fecundity_AIC <- logfec_aic

# correlation tables
# correlation of total female population size and total fecundity
# CON correlation
fecCON_corr <- gt(tidy(corr_fecpopCON)) %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Correlation of female population size and total fecundity: CON")
  
# FP correlation
fecFP_corr <- gt(tidy(corr_fecpopFP)) %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Correlation of female population size and total fecundity: FP")

# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
rm(logfec_aic, corr_fecpopCON, corr_fecpopFP)
```

### Join ANOVA and eta-squared tables

```{r}
ANOVA_names <- ls(pattern = "_ANOVA")

Phenotypes_ANOVA <- ANOVA_names %>% mget(envir = .GlobalEnv) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Table_Name")

etasq_names <- ls(pattern = "_etasq")

Phenotypes_etasquared_df <- etasq_names %>% mget(envir = .GlobalEnv) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Table_Name")

Phenotypes_etasquared <- Phenotypes_etasquared_df  %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 3, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Partial eta-squared values for all phenotype assays")
```

### Load wing morphometrics P-values

```{r}
wing_pvals <- read_csv("../../../Raw_data/wing_pvalues.csv")

wing_pvals <- wing_pvals %>% rename("p.value" = p_value)
```

## Adjust P-values

```{r}
all_pvals_tab <- bind_rows(list(
  Phenotypes_ANOVA = Phenotypes_ANOVA, 
  wing_pvals = wing_pvals, 
  activity_Tukey = activity_Tukey), .id = "df")

all_pvals_tab$adj_pval <- p.adjust(all_pvals_tab$p.value, 
                                   method = 'fdr')

tabs_list <- all_pvals_tab %>% group_split(df)

Phenotypes_ANOVA_adj <- tabs_list[[1]] %>% 
  dplyr::select(1:10, 18)
 
activity_Tukey_adj <- tabs_list[[2]] %>% 
  dplyr::select(13:17, p.value, adj_pval)

wing_pvals_adj <- tabs_list[[3]] %>% 
  dplyr::select(test, effect, p.value, adj_pval)

tabs_anova <- Phenotypes_ANOVA_adj %>% group_split(Table_Name)
```

## Save tables

```{r}
write_csv(wing_pvals_adj, "../../Tables/wing_pvals_adj.csv")
```

#### Save activity assay tables

```{r}
# activity tables
act_aic_tab <- activity_AIC %>% 
  dplyr::select('Model formula' = Modnames, K, AICc, Delta_AICc,
  'AICc weight' = AICcWt, LL) %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(
    title = "AICc results for models fit for activity assay")

act_ANOVA_adj_tab <- tabs_anova[[1]] %>% 
  dplyr::select(-(1:3)) %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "ANOVA table for activity assay")

act_tuk_adj_tab <- activity_Tukey_adj %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Tukey HSD results for activity assay ANOVA")

act_etasq_tab <- activity_etasq %>% dplyr::select(-1, -2) %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "partial eta-squared table for activity assay")

# Save all activity tables into a single docx
gt_group(act_aic_tab, act_ANOVA_adj_tab, act_tuk_adj_tab,
act_etasq_tab) %>% gtsave("../../Tables/activity_tables.docx")
```

factflt_ANOVA_adj_tab <- tabs_anova[[2]] %>%

factflt_etasq_tab <- factflight_etasq %>%

#### Save fecundity assay tables

```{r}
logfec_aic_tab <- fecundity_AIC %>% 
  dplyr::select('Model formula' = Modnames, K, AICc, Delta_AICc,
  'AICc weight' = AICcWt, LL) %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(
    title = "AICc results for models fit for fecundity assay (log fecundity)")

fec_ANOVA_adj_tab <- tabs_anova[[3]] %>% 
  dplyr::select(-(1:2)) %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "ANOVA tables for fecundity assay (1. per-capita fecundity; 2. log-transformed per-capita fecundity)")

fec_etasq_tab <- fecundity_etasq %>% 
  dplyr::select(-1) %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "partial eta-squared table for fecundity assay (1. per-capita fecundity; 2. log-transformed per-capita fecundity)")

corr_names <- list("CON" = fecCON_corr[[1]], "FP" = fecFP_corr[[1]])

fec_corr_tab <- bind_rows(
  corr_names, .id = "Selection") %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "correlation tables for fecundity assay for number of females vs. fecundity")

# Save all fecundity tables into a single docx
gt_group(logfec_aic_tab, fec_ANOVA_adj_tab, fec_etasq_tab, fec_corr_tab) %>% 
  gtsave("../../Tables/fecundity_tables.docx")
```

#### Save evolution of flight performance tables

```{r}
fltevol_ANOVA_adj_tab <- tabs_anova[[4]] %>% 
  dplyr::select(-(1:2)) %>% mutate(Model = case_match(
    Model,
    "Sel_Gen_fact" ~ "Selection \u00D7 Gen",
    "CON_Gen" ~ "Gen (only CON)",
    "FP_Gen" ~ "Gen (only FP)"
  )) %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "ANOVA tables for evoluton of flight performance")

fltevol_etasq_tab <- flightevol_etasq %>% 
  dplyr::select(-1) %>%  mutate(Model = case_match(
    Model,
    "Sel_Gen_fact" ~ "Selection \u00D7 Gen",
    "CON_Gen" ~ "Gen (only CON)",
    "FP_Gen" ~ "Gen (only FP)"
  )) %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 4, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "partial eta-squared tables for evolution of flight performance")

# Save all evolution of flight performance tables into docx
gt_group(fltevol_ANOVA_adj_tab, fltevol_etasq_tab) %>% 
  gtsave("../../Tables/flightevol_tables.docx")
```
